records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Union Systems!
records.body:
Hi Wei,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Union Systems* just joined on the pro plan!

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 0 (2026-06-29) shows initial intent, but 6 days since with no invite, no key milestone, and zero replies to two outreach emails (email:85d9b8af, email:4a156def) and no tickets suggests disengagement. 8 days left; some chance of self-serve return.

draft.subject: A quick hand with your Wrenfield setup?
draft.body:
Hi Wei,

You've got your first project created in Wrenfield, which is the main organizing unit -- tasks live inside them. The next step that usually makes it click is getting someone else in with you: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through whatever next step matters most for Union Systems and answer anything that's come up.

Best,
Chidi
